farm_pond.label: new farm ponds
farm_pond.note: 146 new farm ponds in Jaypur tehsil raised cropping intensity in their zones of influence by about 4.5 points on average (95% range +0.7 to +8.2), compared with the prediction had they not been built. 20 show a likely gain or an early sign of one and 18 a loss, against about 15 each expected by chance. Ponds whose water looks lined: +6.0 points (20 ponds); unlined: +3.6 points (54). Rabi and summer cropping changed by +3.5 points of the zones' cropland. In 2023-24 and 2024-25, with only the micro-watersheds left as comparison, the 155 ponds with data in those years show −0.7 points (an early sign).

headwater_pond.label: new headwater ponds / check dams
headwater_pond.note: 22 new headwater ponds / check dams in Jaypur tehsil show no average change in cropping intensity around them that can be told apart from zero: −2.4 points (95% range −9.7 to +5.2). 3 show a likely gain or an early sign of one and 1 a loss, against about 2 each expected by chance. Rabi and summer cropping changed by −4.0 points of the zones' cropland. In 2023-24 and 2024-25, with only the micro-watersheds left as comparison, the 23 ponds with data in those years show −1.2 points (an early sign).

small_onstream_pond.label: new small on-stream ponds
small_onstream_pond.note: 10 new small on-stream ponds in Jaypur tehsil show no average change in cropping intensity around them that can be told apart from zero: +0.7 points (95% range −9.0 to +8.5). 2 show a likely gain or an early sign of one and 0 a loss, against about 1 each expected by chance. Rabi and summer cropping changed by +6.3 points of the zones' cropland. In 2023-24 and 2024-25, with only the micro-watersheds left as comparison, the 10 ponds with data in those years show −0.2 points (an early sign).

onstream_tank.label: new on-stream tanks
onstream_tank.note: One new on-stream tank in Jaypur tehsil can be assessed so far: −0.6 points of cropping intensity in its zone of influence compared with the prediction had it not been built. One pond is too few to rely on.
